title: Perimeter & Area
description: Class 5 Maths: perimeter and area of rectangles and squares, area of composite shapes, and the difference between perimeter and area — with worked examples and tests.

topics.title: Perimeter
topics.concept:
Perimeter is the total distance around the edge of a shape. Add the lengths of all the sides.

  • Rectangle: P = 2 × (length + width).
  • Square: P = 4 × side.

Perimeter is measured in units of length (cm, m).

topics.title: Area
topics.concept:
Area is the amount of surface a shape covers, measured in square units (cm², m²).

  • Rectangle: A = length × width.
  • Square: A = side × side.

For a composite shape, split it into rectangles, find each area, and add them.

recap: Area = surface covered, in square units (cm², m²).
Rectangle: length × width. Square: side × side.
Composite shapes: split into rectangles and add the areas.
